title: A governed engineering review: pin the tree, take the blast radius, derive the shared context ONCE, fan the lenses out over it, and close only through the gates

steps.claim: the review checked out the code it claims to have reviewed — a target is pinned, and its head is the head of the PR under review
the blast radius was taken against the tree that was reviewed, not against whatever happened to be checked out
the review's own findings file existed before any lens was briefed, so the lenses added to a review rather than becoming it
the diff and the blast radius were written to disk BEFORE the first lens was dispatched — the shared copy has to exist before anyone is told to read it
the lenses were chosen for THIS diff — a routing decision carrying per-lens evidence, and never the --all breadth that switches the applicability engine off
every brief that was dispatched came back with its own findings file — a lens that was briefed and produced nothing is a lens that did not run
the expensive part ran ONCE and was SHARED — no derivation was repeated, and every brief cites the one context copy on disk instead of re-deriving it
the review ran inside its contract and closed through its gates — the contract was active before the first write, DoR before the first write, and DoD before any claim that the work was finished
